definitions.explanation: The name of a company or business. Used in business and news contexts; in conversation people also say {会社|かいしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}.

examples.japanese: {社名|しゃめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{社名|しゃめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The business card shows the company name and address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合併|がっぺい}→合併：04778_gappei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{両社|りょうしゃ}→両社：31608_ryousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{社名|しゃめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{再出発|さいしゅっぱつ}→再出発：19676_saishuppatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After the merger, the two companies made a fresh start under a new name.

notes:
From ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company) + {名|めい} (name).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社名|しゃめい}{変更|へんこう}: change of company name
- {社名|しゃめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改|あらた}める→改める：12923_aratameru⟧: to rename the company (formal)
- {社名入|しゃめいい}り: printed with the company name (pens, towels)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{商号|しょうごう}→商号：19272_shougou⟧: trade name, the legal term
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧: company president
- {社屋|しゃおく}: company building
